thread:
marta: FYI vendor updated lead time for H100 order from ~21d -> 52d. Also changed RMA routing: replacements now originate from EU by default, NA customers will get cross-border swaps. Need rapid mitigation plan.
liam: ouch. what size are we talking?
marta: 30 units total. Allocated 18 to east/central edge pools, 6 for experiments, 6 spare. Current attrition + staging = ~7/week. We lose buffer in ~2.5 weeks at that rate.
raj: vendor offered two paths: 1) ocean + consolidation (cheapest but 6-8w), 2) air-split 10 units now (expedite fees), 3) RMA prioritization for DOA replacements only. What's the uplift?
marta: air split quote: $12k freight + palletization $1.2k; expedite full batch air: $58k. Vendor notes extra AWB per split pallet and customs docs.
tess: cluster state: west-coast pool has 3 failing nodes queued; hotspare count NA=2, EU=5. If we shift load east, we can stall outages but will raise tail latency by 8-12ms for some customers.
liam: is partner loan pool possible? I can reach out to Pulsar partner; they can loan up to 6 units for ~2-3 weeks for $1.5k ops overhead + transfer configs.
marta: vendor RMA change: serial-reconciled returns only. They now require unit photos + serial pairing in ticket. That adds time to RMA creation and requires ops to upload artifacts before replacement ships.
ops-bot: RMA generator available. Use template below and confirm.
```
RMA-LABEL:
vendor: NorthHarbor Logistics
model: H100-80GB
qty: <n>
defect: DOA / perf
auth: PO-9002
origin: EU-AMS
dest: NA-LAX
notes: include photo attachment and serial pairing
```
raj: propose we: a) open RMA batch for 10 units (cover immediate swaps), b) split-air 8 units to NA now, c) request vendor deferral credit for remaining 12 to Q3. Finance likely grants partial deferral (~8-10% credit) if we shift >30% of PO.
liam: quick cost calc: split-air8 = $12k*(8/10)=~$9.6k + pallet $1.2k -> ~10.8k. partner loan ~1.5k. vendor expedite full = $58k. deferral credit could offset $1.5k. Net if we do split+loan+deferral: ~12.3k + ops churn.
tess: fallback: enable CPU fallback on noncritical routes and throttle batch size -> reduces GPU consumption by ~25% buys ~10-12 days. Also prepare quantized replicas (Q4) to cut long tail.
marta: heading into ops/finance thread to confirm. For people here: react with :white_check_mark: to proceed with split-air8 + partner loan + RMA-10 or :x: to reject.
raj: :white_check_mark:
liam: :white_check_mark:
tess: :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-10. Please attach unit photos to ticket RMA-10 within 24h or vendor will delay dispatch. Carrier provisional: SkySwift Air.
marta: I'll open the vendor hold request for consolidation window to avoid extra pallets. Vendor hold terms: free 48h, then $80/day/pallet.
liam: once AWB confirms I'll handle customs paperwork. Assign brokerage to me.
raj: I'll engage Pulsar for loan and start config transfer doc.
tess: rolling reduced capacity changes now; will post impacted canary groups.
marta: procurement tracker updated: https://redwood.company/procure/PO-9002. Will update when AWB/tracking posted.
liam: thanks all, keep this thread updated if vendor pushes any further changes.
